candidate.description: PROC-201 (Find Email) join path evaluation against the outreach domain spine (outreach_id). The subject operates on slot_workbench, which contains outreach_id as a direct column. Two join paths exist: (1) company-level constants joined via outreach_id, (2) person-level variables joined via slot_id. Both are documented in OSAM Section 5 as tree notation. The join resolves — no multi-hop, no fuzzy matching, no ambiguity.

path_1.description: slot_workbench.outreach_id → spine (outreach_id). Company-level constants (domain, company_name, canonical_name, city, state, hunter_email_pattern, vendor_email_pattern) all join on outreach_id.

path_2.description: slot_workbench.slot_id → individual slot. Person-level variables (person_first_name, person_last_name, hunter_email, hunter_confidence, person_email) join on slot_id, which is a child of outreach_id (one outreach_id has many slot_ids).

self_join.description: slot_workbench self-join: outreach_id groups company constants, slot_id identifies individual person slots within that company. Both keys live on the same table — no external hop required.

unresolved_path_count.measurement: Count of proposed join paths that do not resolve to the spine. Both paths resolve: (1) outreach_id is a direct column on slot_workbench, (2) slot_id is a direct column subordinate to outreach_id on the same table. Zero unresolved.

hop_count.measurement: Number of intermediate tables between the subject's primary table and the spine ID. slot_workbench contains outreach_id directly — zero intermediate tables. Self-join does not count as a hop (same table).

ambiguous_path_count.measurement: Count of join paths where the resolution is ambiguous (multiple possible targets, fuzzy match required, or confidence below threshold). Both paths are unambiguous — outreach_id and slot_id are explicit foreign keys on slot_workbench. Zero ambiguity.

format_deviation_count.measurement: Count of join path documentation elements that deviate from the L21 standard format (3-column table: Join Path, Type, Description). The join chain is documented in OSAM Section 5 as tree notation and a Query Routing table, but NOT as a formal L21 3-column DMJ Join table. This is gap G05 from 03-map.json — the content is correct but the format does not conform to the invariant set's L21 schema. One format deviation.

backprop_trigger_count.measurement: Count of join failures that would trigger back-propagation to Define (missing_key_field). The join resolves on all paths. No missing key fields detected — outreach_id (spine) and slot_id (subordinate key) are both present and documented in 02-define.json as elements E09-join-chain and E08-read-table. Zero back-propagation triggers.
